avis.texte: I did not read reviews until I started to suspect this product was indeed the cause of the rash that I developed months ago. Originally, I was unsure exactly what caused the rash/skin irritation on my face, neck and jawline. I discontinued use not knowing what exactly caused this as I had multiple new products that I started using. However, I used this product again recently and by the end of the night the area around my jawline and sides of my face (closest to the ear/sideburn area) started to itch and has continued on the next day. I only applied this product once and washed my face after I started feeling these symptoms. They have continued hours later.

i received a sample size of this product from a friend for christmas. this is the most beautiful serum/sunscreen i have ever tried. immediately makes my skin look even and beautiful. unfortunately this stuff pills so bad it makes it almost completely unusable. pills with every makeup product i have tried over it and even pills with just moisturizer. if it werent for the pilling this would be an absolute staple product for me regardless of the hefty price tag. if you wear no other face makeup this would be good for you, otherwise skip.
I hate the way this looks and I hate the way it feels. It is way too shiny on the face and it feels sticky and suffocating on my skin.

I wanted to like this product and it looks very nice however every time later in the day I'd developed a red rash that looked like my skin had burned a layer off. It also created tiny bumps on my skin. Reading similar reviews now I know for sure it was this product.

I really wanted to love this sunscreen! I sampled it at the store, and it had the most beautiful glow, very luminous. But upon trying it...many times, it PILLED LIKE CRAZY! I have tried changing up my routine, swapping out products, and no matter what I do, this stuff ruins my makeup. By the end of the day, my face is sloughing off like I got a horrible sunburn. I can't believe just how bad it gets, bc I truly haven't had a sunscreen react so wildly to my skincare/makeup.

avis.titre: Pilled Up All Over My Skin!
avis.texte: All that I had previously applied was a bit of milky toner, which had absorbed into my skin completely before I applied this. Even though I started off applying just a small amount, it immediately began to ball up and pill all over my face. I was able to wipe away the rest of it, but I was pretty annoyed that had happened, given the price, and that I used FSA funds to purchase it (because it's got sunscreen, it's an FSA/HSA eligible item). Very disappointed.

This product made my skin so, so angry. My skin is swollen, irritated and itchy. I've developed a rash on my cheeks. I seriously think I've burned layers off of my face. My skin is starting to heal since I quit using it.

I was really enjoying this product until I started becoming unbearably itchy, especially on my jawline, neck, and chest. Eventually even between my fingers would be itchy, and I finally realized that this started when I began using this sunscreen serum. I stopped using it, and the itchiness subsided. I realized that this product contains Bismuth Oxychloride, which has given me problems in the past with other products (for instance, makeup with this ingredient would cause cystic acne and itchiness). I discontinued all products with this ingredient based on an esthetician's advice, and wish I had noticed that it was in this serum! It's the ingredient that gives it a shimmery quality. I hope in the future they make a version without this shimmer, because it was truly great otherwise.

avis.titre: Glowing Skin While Protecting Sensitive Face
avis.texte: Dew Good was a splurge purchase before a vacation to Mexico. Every time I used it, it caused a breakout and bumpy texture to my skin. Gave it to a friend and it caused a rash for her. It's in the trash now. What a waste of money.

avis.titre: This product can cause extreme chemical burns
avis.texte: After about 3 months of using this pretty regularly, one day after coming in from outside my face was tingling. I washed my face and under my makeup it was so red it was almost purple. My neck was itching and burning horribly. My skin was raised and red and radiating heat like a horrible sunburn. I'm talking "been outside for 8 hours in the tropics, in the sun with no sunblock" sunburn. Over the next few days, my swollen and red face went to dry, painful to the touch, covered in tiny bumps and peeling. My neck continued to be red and itchy for almost a week. I used aloe Vera gel, ice packs, nothing helped. I couldnt figure out what caused it and though it mightve been a food allergy, since id already been using this product for 2-3 months with no issues. About 5 months of winter went by where i used a regular face sunblock (not this one) and i had no problems. Took this bottle out last week and used it in the morning before putting on my makeup—same reaction. I realized that was not a coincidence and that thinking back, i had been using this product each time i had this reaction last summer and fall (about 4 times). I went to the one star reviews on this product and low and behold—other peoole have had the exact same reaction. Litterally exact same reaction with all the same symptoms. It seems that theres an ingredient in this that destabilizes over time and causes severe chemical burn reactions. I cant believe that somethjng like this is even allowed to be sold. This is TERR

avis.titre: Radiant shimmer SPF for everyday glow
avis.texte: As a person with fair skin who was not so careful about sun exposure in my teen years, I try to use sunscreen daily to protect my health and keep away any more sunspots. Coola's Dew Good Illuminating Serum offers SPF 30 protection, which provides good coverage for daily use (I'd choose 50 or 70 for more sun-intensive activities, like a beach day). The sleek bottle is a beautiful pearlescent pink, and while the sunscreen seems thick and white when first dispensed, it blends out to a similar pearlescent sheen on my skin. It takes a little work to get it to absorb, but once it does, I don't notice a white cast on my skin tone. The sheen isn't glitter, but rather a fine frosted shimmer that looks radiant. The only downside is that it emphasizes the fine lines around my eyes slightly. The scent is a fresh, clean fragrance that reminds me of a spa — I get notes of cucumber and mint. It even feels slightly cooling on my skin when I apply it, which I enjoy. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

avis.titre: COOLA Dew Good Illuminating Serum with SPF 30
avis.texte: Hello everyone! My name is Aleyda and I am an all things beauty enthusiast! I was so excited to be able to try out the COOLA Dew Good Illuminating Serum with SPF 30. I've quickly become a huge fan of COOLA and haven't been disappointed so far and this serum was not the exception! I absolutely loved this serum so much. It's very lightweight and my skin absorbed it quickly and efficiently. It looks and smells like candy from the box to the bottle. There's nothing better than a serum with a great scent that's lightweight and allergy/sensitive skin friendly. One thing that caught my attention that I noticed was COOLA has Bluescreen protection in its product and that is something I haven't heard much of and would like to see other brands follow their lead on. My only concern with this serum is on my days when my skin is feeling extra oily not to use it under make up as it looks extra greasy. I love wearing it on it's own daily and has became my staple. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

Reasons why I love this..... 1.Provides broad spectrum SPF 30 sun protection, which is crucial for preventing sun damage and premature aging.2.Contains antioxidants like vitamin C and ferulic acid to help brighten and even out skin tone.3.Features light-reflecting minerals to give a subtle, dewy glow or "illuminating" effect.4.Lightweight, non-greasy serum texture that absorbs easily into skin.5. Free of oils, so it shouldn't clog pores or cause breakouts for most people.6.Water-resistant for up to 40 minutes, making it suitable for wearing during activity.7.Formulated without oxybenzone, a controversial sunscreen ingredient. The COOLA Dew Good Serum seems like a solid option for those wanting an antioxidant-rich brightening serum that also provides sun protection with a radiant finish. **This review was collected as part of a promotion.

I love this sunscreen, it is everything the elf halo glow wanted to be. This is the only product i have used that clears my acne without being a true acne targeting product. It has the most beautiful radiance, and is very lightweight. Once the product is starting to run low, though, the pump becomes hard to use. Other than that is perfect.

I loved this product so much I repurchased another bottle. It gave my skin a soft dewy glow. The formula must have changed between purchases because I developed an incredible itch on my face and neck which included a bumpy rash. I eliminated all current products I was using and added back in slowly and much to my chagrin this was the culprit. If you have sensitive skin, beware. If you don't, go for it! I am still disappointed I cant use it anymore.
